title: Common EB reconstruction under bounded observational radius
theorem: For any nonempty finite-dimensional state family with finite closed-convex-hull observational radius r in nats, e_EB <= min(1,400 sqrt((r+1)/ln(1/b2))) for 0<b2<1, and one exact EB map exists at b2=0
independent_new_lemmas: common support and broadcaster center error
supplied_dependency: Allowed frozen checkpoint03 internally audited half-sandwich theorem and compatible smoother; no new originating/root cycle04 proof read
mechanism: Use an observational center in closed conv(E), apply JN substate directly, then reuse the compatible smoothing and included-center sandwich chain to one common full-domain EB channel
strict_separation: Exact permutation family or full unitary orbit: R_obs<=1 while C_chi=(ln2/8)(H_(N+1)-1)+P0 ln(lambda0) tends to infinity
interpretation_limit: Radius does not pointwise dominate capacity: swapped Bernoulli states give R_obs>C_chi
missing_new_lemma: none in this extension, conditional on the allowed frozen checkpoint03 mechanism
test: Exact rational replay of integer likelihood blocks and scalar constants; unrestricted effect bound and asymptotic divergence proved analytically
